trade_cards.name: Brent/WTI 30-45D supply-shock Call Spread
trade_cards.expression: Use the most liquid 30-45D Brent or WTI options; buy 35-40D Call and sell 15-20D Call. If live debit exceeds ~40% of spread width, switch to finite-risk Call Butterfly or skip. Recalculate strikes from live active futures and IV after the contract roll.
trade_cards.entry: Do not chase the first gap. Start half only if active Brent holds 89.5-90.0 for 45-60min and WTI stays >=84.5; add only above Brent 92 with verified new shipping/mining/retaliation/insurance disruption.
trade_cards.invalidation: Brent breaks 87.5 with confirmed de-escalation or meaningful flow recovery, or WTI <82.5 without follow-through catalyst.
take_profit: Brent 103-108 or 75-85% of theoretical max value
time-exit if EIA Sep2 or OPEC+ Sep6 disproves the supply thesis
trade_cards.iv_skew: Friday OVX 43.49 was down 5.91%, but Monday live oil vol surface was not reliably retrieved; do not assume volatility is still cheap.
trade_cards.gap_risk: rapid U.S.-Iran de-escalation plus supply relief can crush both oil and IV

trade_cards.name: QQQ/NDX 14-21D Put Spread
trade_cards.expression: Cover Sep4 NFP; buy 35-40D Put / sell 15-20D Put; enter only if live debit <=35-40% of width. If cash VIX opens >22-25, avoid chasing Vega.
trade_cards.entry: Do not chase >1.5% gap down. Prefer first-hour failed rebound: QQQ below VWAP while Brent >=90 and US2Y >=4.30%; add only on first-hour low break with VIX still <18.
trade_cards.invalidation: QQQ regains the Aug28 high/VWAP zone while Brent <88 and US2Y <4.25%, or weak JOLTS/ISM/NFP causes fast bull-steepening and real-yield compression.
take_profit: QQQ -5% to -6% or ~80% of max spread value
time-exit after Sep4 NFP if catalyst is exhausted
trade_cards.greeks: negative Delta, positive Gamma/Vega, negative Theta
trade_cards.iv_skew: Last official VIX was only 14.43; Monday live NDX/QQQ surface was not fully verified.
trade_cards.gap_risk: oil collapses and weak growth data drive yields lower, reopening tech-duration expansion

trade_cards.name: 2s30s DV01-neutral Flattener
trade_cards.expression: Pay 2Y fixed / Receive 30Y fixed PV01-neutral, or short TU / long US or UB using live CTD DV01.
trade_cards.entry: Do not chase the Friday 88bp reference. Start half only if Monday curve re-steepens to 92-96bp while 2Y>=4.30% and 30Y<=5.28%; add after a re-break below88bp.
trade_cards.invalidation: 2s30s>103bp, or 30Y>5.35% without 2Y rising, or weak NFP drives a fast 2Y rally.
take_profit: take at least 1/3-1/2 before Sep4 NFP if already >5bp profitable
trade_cards.greeks: curve/PV01 exposure rather than option Greeks
trade_cards.max_loss: not finite; stress a 15bp adverse curve move plus an extra 15bp long-end rise
trade_cards.gap_risk: regime flips from Fed-path repricing to fiscal/term-premium shock
trade_cards.risk_budget: trial stress loss 0.35-0.50% NAV; confirmed <=1.0% NAV
